judged_text: findMembers() is now fire-and-forget in setupController (the awaited afterModel promise was removed), so the route renders immediately while user_count still holds its default 0. Every visit to the admin group page shows a flash of '0/0' pagination and an empty member list until the ajax resolves (same pattern in app/assets/javascripts/discourse/routes/group-members.js.es6 lines 5-12 for the public page) — the previously guaranteed 'fully loaded or loading spinner' contract was silently replaced by a transient wrong-state render.

adjudication.rationale: The diff removes the awaited `afterModel` hooks (admin: `app/assets/javascripts/admin/routes/admin_group_route.js`, public: `app/assets/javascripts/discourse/routes/group-members.js.es6`) and replaces them with fire-and-forget `model.findMembers()` calls in `setupController`. The `Discourse.Group` model now defaults `user_count: 0` and does not populate `members` until the AJAX in `findMembers()` resolves (`app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js`). Meanwhile the admin template renders pagination immediately using `{{currentPage}}/{{totalPages}}`, where both computed props return 0 when `user_count == 0` (`admin-group.js.es6`), and the member list iterates `{{each member in members}}` (initially undefined/empty). So the route will render a transient wrong UI state (0/0 + empty list) until the request finishes, which is a behavior regression compared to the previous guaranteed preloaded members in `afterModel`.
